wiki.title: La Keisha Jackson
wiki.extract: La Keisha Jackson is an American politician and member of the Indiana Senate from the 34th district. An Indianapolis City-County Councilor from 2014 to 2024, Jackson is African-American and a member of the Indiana Black Legislative Caucus.
